test_item_count_definition: Started unittest TestCase methods; subtests and non-method fixture events are counted separately, not added again

specification_examples.boundary_reason: Retain script distinctions; do not reduce to primary language.
A non-string first item cannot define the relation.
Full match rejects trailing newline; no trim.
Source timeout is unavailable, not executor failure.
Invalid related field status is malformed serialized input.
A page dictionary does not become a caller SourceBinding.
Legacy true still contains the original exact-true predicate information.
No bool/int coercion in legacy mode.
A present property returning JavaScript undefined is nonboolean, not absent.
Missing raw observation must not fall back to favorable legacy true.
Missing raw observer metadata cannot be inferred from the value.
An unrelated plugins hash error does not imply webdriver getter failure.
Declared boolean success and a string boolean_value contradict the raw record.

limits: Synthetic semantic functions and temporary Git regression fixtures only; U/FAILED can be expected successful test outcomes.
scope: Synthetic and temporary-input-tree tests. Real execution counts are recorded separately in EXECUTION.json.
